title: Sound pass: effects and a bed on the motion promo
caption: The silent 06 motion promo gets a measured sound pass: 22 CC0 effects placed on the visual hits, a music bed generated by the recipe and shifted so every scene cut lands on a beat, mixed to about -16 LUFS.
prompt: Add a sound pass to ../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4, the silent Magnifito motion promo. Put a whoosh on every scene cut (3.2 s, 6.8 s, 9.8 s), small ticks as the words, card rows and chart bars land, a click and a pop when the cursor confirms the control, a riser into the logo scene and an impact when the logo rises at 10.22 s. Only use the bundled CC0 effects. For music, write a small Node script that synthesises a 100 BPM warm pop bed (no samples, no Mixkit) and use it with the sound pass so the cuts land on beats. Credit the bed as generated, mix for the web and tell me the loudness and true peak.
commands: mgvideo sfx ../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4 --cues cues.json --out work/pass --music work/bed.wav --music-db -12 --music-source 'Generated bed: make-bed.mjs in this folder, 100 BPM, synthesised in Node from sine, triangle and seeded noise, no samples' --music-license 'No third-party licence: generated by the recipe and dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0' --use-case 'GitHub Pages showcase' --seed 7
credits: Video: 06-motion-graphics from this showcase (Geist fonts, SIL OFL 1.1; motion engine adapted from Barty-Bart/motion-graphics, MIT)
Music bed: generated by make-bed.mjs in this folder; no third-party audio
Sound effects: CC0 1.0 files bundled with Barty-Bart/motion-graphics (skills/sound-effects), from Freesound and Kenney
